text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first Representative Exchange Race of 
the Senior class is finally underway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moreover, Venus Park, who was favored to 
win last year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, 
announced her entry into the exchange 
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a roster far stronger than the last, 
the curtain rises on the 3rd match of the 
Representative Exchange Race—
